paragraphs: See the entry R' Kahana bar Tachlifa.[^1]

notes.text: The heading calls Rav Kahana the teacher of Rav, not his student. The target abbreviates ר״כ, contextually read as Kahana, and adds bar Tachlifa. R' preserves the target title without transferring full Rav from the differently qualified heading; the previous expansion remains recorded as a contextual inference.
